# One name per line, in the order `abi_probe.c` emits the values.
#
# Both files are read by the workflow: the names from here, the numbers from the built `.ko`, and
# the two counts are compared before the pairs are written out. Renaming a struct member in one
# file and not the other is the mistake this shape makes visible rather than silent.
